transcript: This is the purest form of love. His wife was stuck job hunting for 10 months, so he built her an app that rewrites her resume for every job she applies to. The crazy part? He made it free and you can use it too. It's called Dossier. His wife is a junior software engineer and her job search dragged on for almost 10 months. So many portals and rewriting her resume for every job took ages. She fills in her profile once. She pastes a job posting, or let's Dossier pull openings from LinkedIn, Indeed, and more. It reads what the company wants and writes a tailored resume, a cover letter, and the email in 12 designs and 21 languages. But here's the crazy part: it refuses to lie. If the job asked for a skill she doesn't have, it never fakes it. It shows her the gap instead. It tracks every application on a board from draft to offer. And with a local AI, your data never leaves your laptop. Once it worked for her, he made it open source. Over 700 developers have starred it. Then came the twist. A stranger asked him to stop sharing it, saying it would flood companies with AI resumes. He said no, because Dossier never applies for anyone. You read it, you check it, you hit send. The honest part, setup takes some patience and it's not for phones, but someone has already tweaked it to search Bangalore jobs by default. Someone you love has been job hunting for months, send them this. I've put the full setup guide in my WhatsApp community for free. Click the link in bio.
